channel.title: Vishwaclaudema: This week in Claude
channel.description: What changed in Claude this week.

item.title: This week in Claude · No. 4
item.description: Fast mode is out of preview for Claude Opus 5.5; OpenTelemetry export for the API and Managed Agents (beta); Claude Code 2.1.297 to 2.1.303: idle compaction and fork sub-agents on by default; Standalone Claude Design closes on 14 December 2026; Claude Desktop gets a session rail, saved environments and nested sessions

item.title: This week in Claude · No. 3
item.description: Claude Haiku 5.5 is out, and code written for Haiku 4.5 can break on it; Prompt cache reads on Sonnet 5.5 now cost half as much; Managed Agents can write their own workflows (beta); Claude Code 2.1.292 to 2.1.296: hooks can fail closed, sub-agents take an effort level; Max and Team plans now include monthly API credits

item.title: This week in Claude · No. 2
item.description: Anthropic's guide to prompting Claude Opus 5.5; The Models API now says which model line each model belongs to

item.title: This week in Claude · No. 1
item.description: Claude Sonnet 5.5 is out; Code written for Sonnet 5 can break on Sonnet 5.5; Claude Sonnet 4.5 retires from the API on 30 November 2026; Make a Google Doc, Sheet or deck straight from a chat
